newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid air cargo rose 14.8 percent in April.
newsitem.headline: Madrid air cargo rose 14.8 percent in April.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Madrid's Barajas airport rose 14.8 percent in April to 22,093 tonnes, compared with the same month last year, the airport authority said.
This takes the total for the first four months of this year to 87,362 tonnes.

Strong growth in internal cargo traffic accounted for much of the April increase, which follows a rise in cargo volume of only 1.3 percent in March. Domestic traffic rose 22.8 percent to 7,310 tonnes and international traffic grew 11.2 percent to 14,783 tonnes.
The airport authority AENA said the figures were provisional and accumulated and comparative figures for the four month period were not yet available.

Passenger numbers rose 8.6 percent in April to 1.98 million, or 7.31 million in the four month period, and the number of air transport movements increased 8.0 percent to 21,625, taking the four month total to 84,640. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
